architecture_style: Event-driven microservices on Azure Container Apps: a React dashboard and a FastAPI REST API in front, with webhook-triggered scan and README-build workers decoupled through Azure Service Bus queues.
technology_stack: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server
Azure Monitor, Application Insights and Log Analytics

components.name: web-app
components.purpose: React single-page dashboard where maintainers link repositories, review and accept, edit or reject README diff proposals, and manage their plan.
components.technology: React single-page application served from Azure Container Apps

components.name: api
components.purpose: REST API for authentication, repository linking, README proposals and tier-limit checks. Single backend entry point for the dashboard.

components.name: webhook-receiver
components.purpose: Receives GitHub App push webhooks, validates their signatures and enqueues scan jobs on the scan-jobs queue.

components.name: repo-scanner-worker
components.purpose: Takes read-only shallow clones of linked repositories, parses them with tree-sitter and extracts structured facts (entry points, dependencies, configuration, CI setup). Scales on Service Bus queue depth.

components.name: readme-builder-worker
components.purpose: Assembles the README context from extracted facts, calls the LLM to draft prose and produces the README diff proposal for maintainer review.

components.name: billing-service
components.purpose: Enforces tier limits (Free 1 linked repository, Pro up to 10) and synchronises subscription state with Stripe.

data_stores.name: ReadmeForge PostgreSQL database
data_stores.technology: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server, zone-redundant, primary write region Central India (Pune)
data_stores.contents: Accounts, linked repositories, scan result metadata, README proposals and subscription state.

data_stores.name: Redis cache
data_stores.contents: User sessions, rate-limiting counters and scan job de-duplication keys. Holds no data that cannot be rebuilt.

data_stores.name: Service Bus messaging
data_stores.contents: The scan-jobs queue with its dead-letter queue, and the proposal-events topic.

data_stores.name: Blob Storage
data_stores.technology: Azure Blob Storage with RA-GRS replication
data_stores.contents: Temporary repository snapshots (automatically deleted after 24 hours) and generated README artifacts.

data_stores.name: Key Vault
data_stores.contents: GitHub App private key, Stripe keys and the LLM API key.

integrations.name: GitHub (GitHub App)
integrations.purpose: Notifies ReadmeForge of repository pushes and lets it read repository contents for scanning.
integrations.data_exchanged: Push event payloads inbound; read-only repository contents and metadata outbound.
integrations.authentication: GitHub App installation tokens (private key held in Key Vault); webhook payloads verified by HMAC signature

integrations.name: Anthropic API
integrations.purpose: Drafts README prose from the structured facts extracted from a repository.
integrations.data_exchanged: Extracted repository facts and prompt context outbound; drafted README text inbound.
integrations.authentication: API key stored in Key Vault

integrations.name: Stripe
integrations.purpose: Bills Pro subscriptions and keeps subscription state in sync.
integrations.data_exchanged: Customer and subscription identifiers, plan and payment status; no card data is handled by ReadmeForge.
integrations.authentication: Stripe secret API key in Key Vault outbound; Stripe webhook signing secret inbound

integrations.name: Zendesk
integrations.purpose: Creates and updates Pro customer support tickets.
integrations.data_exchanged: Ticket subject, description, requester email and account plan.

integrations.name: PagerDuty
integrations.purpose: Pages the engineering on-call rotation when Azure Monitor alerts fire.
integrations.data_exchanged: Alert name, severity, affected environment and a link to the alert.

integrations.name: GitHub OAuth
integrations.protocol: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow over HTTPS
integrations.purpose: Lets users sign in to ReadmeForge with their GitHub identity.
integrations.data_exchanged: Authorization code and access token exchange; GitHub user id, login and verified email.
integrations.authentication: OAuth client id and secret; client secret held in Key Vault

notes: All components run in Azure Container Apps, one Container Apps environment per location, with Azure Front Door routing traffic to the nearest healthy location. All data stays in India. The database has a single primary write region (Central India, Pune) with South India (Chennai) as the paired disaster-recovery region.
